skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.when_to_use: Interview about the spec, close open questions and record decisions.

skills.name: to-spec
skills.when_to_use: Turn the result of a grilling session into a refined spec.

skills.name: to-tickets
skills.when_to_use: Break a spec into tickets, phase by phase.

skills.name: tlc-spec-driven
skills.when_to_use: A feature where what to build is still open, or that spans several modules.

skills.name: tlc-spec-lean
skills.when_to_use: A feature small enough for one plan: one module, behaviour already clear.

skills.name: tlc-implement
skills.when_to_use: Work already planned: a spec, ticket or checklist exists and only the build is left.

skills.name: the-judge
skills.when_to_use: A pull request to review, posted to GitHub. Needs an authenticated gh CLI.

skills.name: harness-eval
skills.when_to_use: AGENTS.md, rules or the skills themselves need an audit.

workflows.name: matt-pocock
workflows.when_to_use: Start from a conversation: grill the idea, write the spec, cut tickets, build one ticket per session.

workflows.name: tlc
workflows.when_to_use: Spec-driven features with an independent verifier. Pick tlc-spec-driven when the work needs a task breakdown to stay ordered, tlc-spec-lean otherwise.

workflow_rule: One feature stays in one workflow from spec to verification. Quality skills pair with either workflow.

tools.name: harness-score
tools.when_to_use: Measure the maturity of the repo's agent harness (L0-L4): at project start and at each milestone.
